# copick export tiltseries

<span class="source-badge source-badge--core" title="Part of copick core">core</span>

*Export tilt series as MRC, TIFF or Zarr stacks.*

## Usage

```bash
copick export tiltseries [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Writes each selected tilt series as '<run>.mrc' (or .tif, .zarr) with its nominal tilt angles ('<run>.rawtlt',
'<run>.tlt' or AreTomo3's '<run>_TLT.txt' with acquisition order and dose) and, optionally, its CTF fits.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `-c, --config` | path | — | Path to the configuration file. |
| `--run-names, -r` | text · multiple | — | Specific run names to process (default: all runs). Repeatable; pass -r once per run. |
| `--tiltseries-uri` | text | **required** | Tilt series to export (e.g. 'raw'). |
| `--output-dir` | directory | **required** | Output directory for exported files. |
| `--output-format` | choice (mrc \| tiff \| zarr) | `mrc` | Format of the stack. |
| `--level` | integer | `0` | Pyramid level (mrc, tiff). |
| `--angles` | choice (rawtlt \| tlt \| aretomo3-tlt \| none) | `rawtlt` | Angle file to write next to the stack. |
| `--ctf-format` | choice (aretomo3 \| ctffind4 \| none) | `none` | CTF file to write next to the stack. |
| `--debug / --no-debug` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable debug logging. |

## Examples

```bash
copick export tiltseries -c config.json --tiltseries-uri raw --output-dir out --angles aretomo3-tlt \
    --ctf-format aretomo3
```
